page0.text:
"...Um, Illya, I guess?"
I just say the first name that comes to mind.

page1.text:
"Yeah! You're one lucky duck, Shirou!"
Illya hugs me tightly.
As an older brother figure, I'm more than happy about that,

page2.text: but Tohsaka doesn't look amused in the slightest. It's enough to cancel out the joy, no, put me in the negative, actually.

page3.text:
"...Hmph. You like making children happy, huh? You're pretty childish yourself, Emiya. Don't tell me you're into little girls?"
Aaargh... To make matters worse, she's back to calling me "Emiya."
She's giving me a wince-inducing look reserved for the utter dregs of society.

page4.text:
Heh, you're embarrassing yourself, Rin. It isn't very ladylike to lose your temper just because you got dumped. That's why Shirou doesn't like you.
"Ngh...! Y-you don't know what you're talking about, you precocious little brat!
I'm just stating normal social values, and first of all, who are you calling dumped...!?"

page5.text:
Tohsaka roars like a tiger.
Illya giggles and hugs me tighter.

page6.text:
"See, Shirou? Rin's so scary.
But don't worry. I'll protect you, no matter what she tries!"

page7.text:
Illya beams.
I'm happy to see that.
Twice as happy as I was a moment ago, actually.
...But now I'm getting a look so cold and judgmental I can't possibly defend myself against it, so can we move on?

page8.text:
"What? If you've got something to say, say it."
"Oh, it's nothing. Your tastes have nothing to do with me, Emiya. I have criticisms, but I won't voice them.
...But seriously, why?"
She asks me bluntly.
However...

page9.text:
"Um. What do you mean, why?"
Even I'm not really sure why I chose Illya. It's like it happened on instinct.

page10.text:
"...I can't believe this. Are you seriously one of those people?"
"L-like hell I am, idiot! I just picked her because I felt like it. I'm basically Illya's guardian now anyway, so it only makes sense I'd choose her...!"

page11.text:
Aargh. The man doth protest too much, methinks.
"Yeah! Shirou's my Servant now!"
Tohsaka looks exasperated, while Illya is jumping for joy.

page12.text:
"...Looks like you've got your fighting spirit back. If you're going to insist on it that hard, I'll respect your choice, but I feel bad for Sakura."
...
I'm curious.
I'm extremely curious what "choice" Tohsaka thinks I'm making.

page13.text:
"But don't forget. Even if you don't use it, that arm belongs to me.
...You have an obligation to serve me in Archer's place.
Your body doesn't belong only to you anymore."

page14.text:
...
She's right.
Tohsaka lost Archer, and Archer's arm saved my life.
...That means I have to help her in his stead.

page15.text:
"...Yeah, I know. Setting aside the fact that you keep calling me a Servant, I'll let you decide our next steps.
I'm out of ideas at this point, so any knowledge you can spare would give me a surer idea of what to do."

page16.text: "That's right. I'll do the thinking, while you do the work. We're in the same boat now, so I'll be working you hard."
